prompt: Build a 5-qubit circuit that prepares the GHZ state (|00000> + |11111>) / sqrt(2), up to global phase. This circuit will be transpiled for a 5-qubit LINEAR coupling map (qubit i is only physically adjacent to qubit i-1 and i+1 — no all-to-all connectivity), so prefer a construction that keeps two-qubit gates between nearby qubit indices where possible.
